content:
I am using codespaces on an iPad with the lean4 extension installed. It works fine until the Infoview loads. The window appears , but all the text, ie messages, overwrite the code window, making it pretty unusable. I have tried Safari, Chrome, Firefox: All the same problem.

One work around is to open infoview in separate window, ie separate safari tab. It’s ok but not ideal. Is there a solution to original problem
